card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in section cross-references such as (2.6) or 5.6, mostly in highlights of prescribing information. It also fires on digits inside numeric tables.

modes.label: Section cross-reference
modes.description: Final digit of a section number in parentheses, like 2.5 or 12.5, pointing to a label section.

modes.label: Table numbers
modes.description: A digit within a number in a table of values.

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a section number, as in "see section 2.6", in a drug label.
